cat > /tmp/verify_enis.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash regions=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") for region in "${regions[@]}"; do echo "=== Region: $region ===" echo "--- Subnets in $region ---" aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --query 'Subnets[].[SubnetId, VpcId, CidrBlock, Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0]]' --output text echo "" echo "--- Network Interfaces in $region ---" aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --query 'NetworkInterfaces[].[NetworkInterfaceId, SubnetId, InstanceId, Status]' --output text done EOF chmod +x /tmp/verify_enis.sh /tmp/verify_enis.sh
